Milestone 2a: comparisons. This is `m2a-implementation` with `main` merged in (conflicts in AGENTS.md, decisions.md and justfile resolved; decisions run 120 to 138 in order).

**What ships:** `sbxm run` (2-4 contestants x harness x model x profile, in parallel, in throwaway sandboxes, `repeat` as sequential waves), the shared headless-execution primitive (Claude, Codex, Antigravity), seeded workspaces with a host-owned baseline commit, `run.json` and per-contestant results, `sbxm run init` and `sbxm run show`, executable checks, a rubric LLM judge with blind labels, and scoring and ranking. Antigravity authenticates with the `google` secret (decision 137).

**Deferred out of M2a (decision 138):** cosine similarity (slice 12; `[eval.cosine]` is refused with a clear error) and Jev (slice 14, spike S9).

**Checked:** host gates on the merged tree: fmt, clippy, `cargo test` and Pester (184 tests) all pass. Slice 13 end-to-end check on real `sbx` passed on 2026-10-01 (`reviews/2026-10-01-slice-13-end-to-end.md`). The earlier milestone review is `reviews/2026-09-30-milestone-2a.md`; its must-fix issues #41 and #42 are fixed.

**Closing keywords:** Fixes #39, Fixes #41, Fixes #42, Fixes #45.

Open should-fix items stay open: #31, #32, #36, #38.
